recommendation.option: Coursera (IBM Data Analyst or Meta Data Analyst certificate)
recommendation.headline: Coursera's IBM or Meta certificate is the best-verified fit for a recognised Python certificate, but expect a long haul at 5 hours a week.
recommendation.summary: Coursera offers the best-evidenced recognised certificates with Python content; hands-on strength and DataCamp's credential status are unverified.

reasons.text: IBM and Meta certificates teach Python; Google's uses R.
Coursera partners with major universities and companies; platform certificates carry brand recognition.

tradeoffs.text: Long programs; low MOOC completion; a 300-hour course at 5 hours/week takes over a year.

alternatives.when: You prioritise hands-on practice and can accept an unverified credential.
You want a free, well-known certificate for programming basics.
Portfolio projects matter more than a certificate.

caveats: Coursera time estimates and prices conflict across sources.
DataCamp accreditation is single-source and contradicted.
nextSteps: Check the current IBM/Meta duration and price on Coursera.
Check DataCamp's certificate accreditation on its own site.

contradictions.assessment: Source 7 (now lower reliability) says accredited; sources 2/5 say not accredited but older. Unresolved; treat as unverified.
